channel.title: Muhammad Basit Ali
channel.description: Open-source tooling for AI agent security and cloud security: Claude Code skill packs, MCP servers and linters, threat modelling, Semgrep rules and an AI agent incident dataset.

item.title: skill-scan-gate v0.4.0
item.description: Release v0.4.0 of skill-scan-gate: CI gate for Claude Code skills and plugins, with SARIF output. GitHub Action and CLI.

item.title: scp-guardrails v0.3.0
item.description: Release v0.3.0 of scp-guardrails: Build AWS service control policies from a short spec and lint them for lockouts and statements that deny nothing.

item.title: mcp-tools-lint v0.3.0
item.description: Release v0.3.0 of mcp-tools-lint: Lint MCP tool schemas and annotations before clients reject them.

item.title: mcp-server-template v0.3.0

item.title: mcp-egress v0.2.0
item.description: Release v0.2.0 of mcp-egress: Record every host an MCP server contacts, per tool, and fail CI on new ones.

item.title: llms-txt-gen v0.3.0
item.description: Release v0.3.0 of llms-txt-gen: Generate llms.txt for any docs site or repository.

item.title: garak-mcp-probes v0.2.0
item.description: Release v0.2.0 of garak-mcp-probes: Run garak against your own MCP servers, with detectors for denied tool calls, leaked canaries and runaway step counts.

item.title: compliance-evidence-skills v0.6.0
item.description: Release v0.6.0 of compliance-evidence-skills: Compliance evidence skills for Claude Code: integrity-checked evidence packs from GitHub, AWS and Microsoft 365 exports, mapped to ISO 27001 and SOC 2, with narratives that cite evidence or say not assessable.

item.title: claude-skills v0.4.0
item.description: Release v0.4.0 of claude-skills: Every skill I maintain, in one repository: 87 skills in 13 plugins from the packs below, one marketplace, one install script, synced daily.

item.title: claude-code-tooling-skills v0.4.0
item.description: Release v0.4.0 of claude-code-tooling-skills: Claude Code skills for keeping a Claude Code setup safe: review a third-party skill before installing it, lint skill descriptions, audit the context budget, build least-privilege permissions, test hooks.

item.title: aws-security-skills v0.5.0
item.description: Release v0.5.0 of aws-security-skills: AWS security skills for Claude Code: account audit, SCP guardrails, blast-radius landing zones, IAM least privilege, Security Hub triage.

item.description: Release v0.3.0 of agent-identity-governance-skills: Claude Code skills for agent identity governance: inventory the non-human identities agents run as, review permissions, recertify quarterly, catch expiring credentials, switch one off fast.

item.title: Do MCP server READMEs tell you which version to run?
item.description: I read the install commands in the READMEs of 264 public MCP servers. 95.5% never name an exact version, and a quarter ask for the latest release on every launch.

item.title: ways-of-working-skills v0.4.0
